allow: PowerShell($gh = Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($gh\) { Write-Output "gh found: $\($gh.Source\)"; gh auth status } else { Write-Output "gh NOT installed" })

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\GitHubCLI\\gh.exe"\); $found = $paths | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }; if \($found\) { Write-Output "FOUND: $found" } else { Write-Output "gh.exe not present in standard install locations" }; winget --version 2>$null)
